title: Schema Registry Entry v1
description: A single runtime-registered contract entry written to the canopy or rhizome runtime registry when a new contract type is registered without a code deploy. This contract governs the registration EVENT — persistence, deduplication, and query are owned by the consuming runtime.

schema_version.description: Contract version. Always '1.0' for this schema.

contract_id.description: Unique identifier for this contract type. Must follow slug naming: lowercase alphanumeric and hyphens, ending with a version suffix (e.g. 'canopy-agent-lease-v1'). The pattern also enforces non-empty and non-whitespace.

display_name.description: Human-readable name for this contract type. Suitable for display in registry UIs and operator surfaces.

description.description: Description of what this contract represents and how it is used. May include producer intent and consumer expectations.

json_schema.description: The inline JSON Schema that defines the payload shape for this contract. Treated as an opaque object — not further validated at this layer.

producer.description: Free-form identifier for the system or component that emits this contract type. Examples: 'canopy', 'rhizome', 'hymenium'.

consumers.description: List of free-form identifiers for systems or components that consume this contract type.

registered_at.description: Unix timestamp (seconds) when this contract type was registered. Set by the registering caller at registration time.

deprecated.description: Whether this contract type is deprecated. Consumers should prefer the superseding contract when true.

superseded_by.description: The contract_id of the replacement contract type, if this entry is deprecated and superseded. Null if there is no direct replacement.
